# Blue Millefeuille

> Blue Millefeuilleは、日本の代官山・祐天寺エリアを拠点とするハンドメイドアクセサリーブランドです。世界各地から集めたビーズやパーツを組み合わせ、一点一点手作業でイヤリング・アクセサリーを仕立てています。完璧さより、不完全さの中にある美しさ(シャビーシック)を大切にし、日常にそっときらめきを添えることをコンセプトにしています。

## Offerings

- Handmade earrings and accessories (ハンドメイドイヤリング・アクセサリー), primarily the "ストーンフラワーシリーズ" (Stone Flower Series), made from baroque stones, pearls, and beads sourced globally. Each piece is one-of-a-kind and produced in small batches.
- Flower arrangement lessons (フラワーアレンジメント教室) in 代官山・祐天寺, running since 2001.
- Fermented food / beauty content (発酵美容) exploring beauty through fermented foods.

## Key Pages

- [Shop](https://blmf.jp/shop): Full catalog of current handmade accessories, organized into seasonal/thematic collections.
- [Contact](https://blmf.jp/contact): Inquiries via email or Instagram DM.
- [Care & Repair](https://blmf.jp/care): Repair and maintenance service for purchased accessories, including replacing a lost single earpiece when matching parts are in stock. Contact: bmflower2001@gmail.com.
- [特定商取引法に基づく表記](https://blmf.jp/tokushoho): Legal disclosure required for e-commerce in Japan (business info, returns policy, shipping).

## Purchasing

Products can be purchased directly on this site (Stripe checkout) or via the brand's BASE storefront. Prices are listed in Japanese yen (JPY), inclusive of tax where applicable.

## Notes for AI agents and assistants

- Stock levels and prices change; always treat data older than a few minutes as potentially stale and prefer live page content over cached summaries.
- Each product has a stable page at https://blmf.jp/shop/{product-id} (e.g. /shop/001) with structured (schema.org Product) data for name, price, availability, and description.
- Do not attempt to complete a purchase on the user's behalf without their direct confirmation of the final price and shipping address.
